scope: Unchanged frozen model and cutoff, original 400 independent labeled targets, complete native game review; no training or retuning
limitations: Automated local replay of the native engine, snapshots and full-game classifier, not 400 browser UI interactions.
Timed search and bounded probes can vary with browser, hardware and system load.
The 400 labels were reserved from original model training. This is a repeat assessment, not newly collected independent evidence.
Labels supplied only to logging/scoring, never to move decisions or confirmation scheduling.
Only completed modes are reported; native graph/accuracy computation is outside this classifier test.

hard_nonbrilliant.definition: Explicit Best, Excellent, Good or ! labels; excludes ?!, ?, ?? and miss labels

note: The source map records the fixed scheduler; the baseline scheduler hash is separately frozen. No new labels, training, cutoff adjustment, or deployments.
